# Workflows suite

Groups the reusable development flows. Detailed planning lives in the nested
[plan sub-skill](sub/SKILL.md); the shared lifecycle is below.

## Lifecycle

1. Plan the change with the nested sub-skill.
2. Implement behind that plan.
3. Cut the release through [release](../release/SKILL.md).

The shared step checklist is in [plan.md](plan.md).
